items.title: Desearch (SN22) Builds Open-Source Tool to Track Customer Complaints on X
items.body: Desearch introduces Open Complaint Radar, a low-cost tool built on Bittensor that tracks customer complaints on X and identifies recurring issues.

items.title: Chutes (SN64) Becomes Launch Partner for Tencent’s New Hy4 AI Model
items.body: Chutes partners with Tencent Cloud to launch Hy4 on Bittensor, bringing advanced vision, computer-use capabilities, and competitively priced AI inference.

items.title: While Crypto Markets Crash, Bittensor Teams Push Ahead With New AI Systems
items.body: As crypto markets dump generally, Bittensor teams advance decentralized AI with new models, distributed training, faster inference, and research systems…

items.title: Bittensor’s Quantum-Resistant Wallets Are Now in Code
items.body: Bittensor’s quantum-resistant wallets are now in code, with three post-quantum signature options and optional automatic key rotation to protect TAO…

items.title: Bittensor Produces the World’s Top-Ranked Decision Model With REAX 1.3
items.body: REAX produced the world's top-ranked decision model in weeks, using open miner competition and model blending to achieve a score of 74.0.

items.title: Reliquary (SN81) Post-Trained a 9B Model That Beats Qwen3.5-9B on Five Benchmarks
items.body: Reliquary post-trained Teutonic-I-Reliquary with 161 miners. The 9B model beat Qwen3.5-9B on five of eight benchmarks and scored 43.6% on SWE-bench Verified.
